name: Portal
description: `Portal` renders children outside their React parent's DOM subtree while preserving React context.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the children are rendered. Defaults to the shared portal root.

props.name: onMount
props.description: Called once the children have been rendered into the container.

props.name: container
props.description:
Default destination for `Portal` and every Primer floating part beneath it, including tooltips that controls
such as `IconButton` render internally. `undefined` inherits the outer default; `null` makes portals wait for a
container instead of falling back to the document. Explicit `container` props and `portal={false}` still win.
